newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel holders seek longer concession.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel holders seek longer concession.

text.p: Eurotunnel shareholder group ADACTE asked British Prime Minister John Major on Monday to extend the Channel Tunnel operator's licence.

"We ask Prime Minister John Major to see beyond his domestic political worries and extend the concession of the tunnel beneath the channel," Albert Jauffret, president of the Association for the Defence of Eurotunnel Shareholders, told Reuters.
The association has already made a similar request to the French government.
Jauffret said extending the operating licence would allow the company to better pay down the general operating expenses of the company and reassure the banks.
ADACTE is studying the possibility of holding a referendum among Eurotunnel's 600,000 French shareholders on the merits of the debt rescheduling plan agreed between Eurotunnel and its banks.
ADACTE says it represents 2,000 small shareholders who hold 10 million voting rights or about four percent of Eurotunnel.
